answer: Operator-Bound Reputation Quarantine: each new identity starts with its operator's reputation pool, and any identity later proven sybil poisons that whole pool—freezing issuance rights for every identity the operator runs. An attacker must therefore sacrifice a garden of established accounts per fake, not one wallet. Cost is the full reputation capital and future revenue of all linked identities; a pearl of verified history is lost permanently, and rebuilding requires a fresh quill of audited work under a new operator.
